scenario_title: SQS visibility timeout shorter than processing time
title: Processing errors on billing-svc

detection.alert: billing-svc: error-log rate > 20/min (CloudWatch Logs metric filter)

impact: Background processing failed; customer-visible data was delayed or wrong on billing-svc
symptom: [ANOMALY] billing-svc 2026-04-16 07:30-11:20: billing-svc: 252 of 342 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-04-16 07:30 and 2026-04-16 11:20 UTC (peak error ratio 0.87 vs baseline median 0.0). 3 error templates, 2 first seen in this span.
error_templates: c.f.b.consumer.UsageEventConsumer - duplicate key value violates unique constraint "invoice_lines_usage_event_id_key"
c.f.b.api.UsageController - account <*> requested usage for a closed period

_templates.macro: Terraform change cut {key} {old} -> {new} s, shorter than billing-svc's processing time; messages became visible again mid-processing and were billed twice (duplicate-key errors).
_templates.remediation: Restore visibility_timeout_seconds = {old} on {resource}; make the consumer idempotent.

culprit.diff:
@@ -68,3 +68,3 @@ aws_sqs_queue.usage_queue
 resource "aws_sqs_queue" "usage_queue" {
-  visibility_timeout_seconds = 300
+  visibility_timeout_seconds = 30
   tags = local.tags

rca.macro: Terraform change cut sqs_visibility_timeout_s 300 -> 30 s, shorter than billing-svc's processing time; messages became visible again mid-processing and were billed twice (duplicate-key errors).
rca.remediation: Restore visibility_timeout_seconds = 300 on aws_sqs_queue.usage_queue; make the consumer idempotent.

action_items: Require a reviewed `terraform plan` and a CloudWatch alarm for the changed AWS resource.
Alert on the error signature `c.f.b.consumer.UsageEventConsumer - message <*> received <*> times`.
